instruction: When a new row is added to Google Sheets 'Applications', check that the CV link is accessible. If the link is broken, comment back in Slack asking for a valid link and skip the rest of the workflow.

When a Calendly meeting is booked, assign it to an owner based on meeting type. If no matching owner is found, create the event in a shared 'Unassigned Meetings' Notion database and notify me on Slack.

instruction: When a Typeform response is submitted, validate that the phone number is present and correctly formatted. If validation fails, store the response in a 'Needs Fixing' Google Sheet and notify the submitter by email.

input.body:
Hello {{trigger.answers.name}},

Thank you for your submission. However, we noticed that the phone number provided appears to be incomplete or incorrectly formatted.

Phone provided: {{step_1.phone}}

Please reply to this email with your correct phone number in format: +1 (123) 456-7890

Thank you!

instruction: Every hour, pull new orders from Shopify and append them to Google Sheets. If the sheet update fails, retry once; if it still fails, post the order IDs to Slack so they can be handled manually.

When a new message is posted in #content-requests on Slack, generate a draft using an AI step and save it to Notion. If the AI output is empty or incomplete, ask the requester for clarification and stop the workflow.

input.prompt:
Create a content draft based on the following request. Provide a complete draft with title, introduction, main points, and conclusion.

Request: {{trigger.text}}

input.text:
Hi <@{{trigger.user}}>! 👋

I wasn't able to generate a complete draft from your request. Could you please provide more details?

Original request: {{trigger.text}}

Please include:
• The topic or subject
• Key points to cover
• Target audience
• Desired tone (formal/casual)

✅ <@{{trigger.user}}> Your content draft has been created and saved to Notion!

Please review and edit as needed.
